content.about: Peru is in western South America, with desert coast, Andes and Amazon. It was the heart of the Inca Empire. Its food is famous. Lake Titicaca lies on its border.

standout.text: Machu Picchu is a 15th-century Inca citadel high in the Andes.

didYouKnow: Peru has thousands of potato varieties.
The Nazca Lines are huge desert drawings.
